notes.title: Five Dates Sequel OUT NOW
notes.content:
[h3]Happy Valentine's Day! [/h3]

Ten Dates, sequel to the beloved classic to Five Dates is now available! Meet your new crush across on Steam, mobile, Playstation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch! Couples and singles alike can have fun exploring this live-action, interactive rom-com. 

Starring Misha and Ryan, two millennial Londoners in search of their special someone at a speed dating event. Speed daters can witness how their choices can strengthen or weaken relationships with potential love matches. As Misha and Ryan attempt to charm five distinct personalities each, they’ll face daunting ice-breaker challenges, shocking revelations, and plenty of awkward moments. Long conversations and deep questions lead to a variety of different outcomes.

notes.title: Brand New Trailer for Five Dates Sequel
notes.content:
With Valentine’s Day just around the corner, together with developers Good Gate Media we wanted to share a brand new launch trailer for our interactive romantic comedy Ten Dates, slated for launch on PC, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Switch, iOS and Android devices on February 14. A free demo is now available for PC and Mac via [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946070/Ten_Dates/]Steam[/url].

Meet your new crush in Ten Dates’ new launch trailer below:

[previewyoutube=b-po5EYQ7O4;full][/previewyoutube]

As the sequel to Five Dates, the live-action FMV game will star Misha and Ryan, two millennial Londoners in search of their special someone at a speed dating event. 

Speed daters can witness how their choices can strengthen or weaken relationships with potential love matches. As Misha and Ryan attempt to charm five distinct personalities each, they’ll face daunting ice-breaker challenges, shocking revelations, and plenty of awkward moments. Long conversations and deep questions lead to a variety of different outcomes. 

'Attraction, dating and love are universal experiences we can all identify with,’ says director and writer Paul Raschid, ‘Our ambition for ‘Ten Dates' was to expand the world of ‘Five Dates' into a richer and more authentic range of dating options. The writing team included LGBTQ+ consultants who we worked with closely across the interactive storylines. We hope the result is a more inclusive experience which encourages people to try a variety of suitors. I’m really proud of what we’ve achieved and hope the audience will feel the same way.’

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42628831/24634a954843c723aa5f6c0daba285b70cedff19.png[/img]

[h2]Key Features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Play as a female (Misha) or male (Ryan) Londoner looking for love

[*] Talent includes Rosie Day (Outlander), Charlie Maher (Conversations with Friends), Meaghan Martin (Camp Rock), Sagar Radia (Industry), Sam Buchanan (The Power), Kaine Zajaz (The Witcher), Ellie James (I May Destroy You), and Rhiannon Clements (Death On The Nile)

[*] Features LGBTQ+ and disability representation

[*] Real-time relationship status tracking evolves based on choices and influences the story

[*] Branching narrative and multi-directional chain of conversation topics

[*] Streamer mode and full controller support
[/list]
Ten Dates - on it's way for Valentine's Day!

Check out more information and follow us on socials for the latest news and updates!

notes.title: Ten Dates is coming to Steam Next Fest October 2022!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946070/Ten_Dates]Ten Dates[/url] is coming to Steam's Next Fest October 2022 Edition! The demo will allow you to play as Misha or Ryan as they navigate their post-pandemic love lives in the unpredictable world of speed dating. 

The demo has 2 very different dates available, each with their own multi-directional chain of conversation topics you can explore including: ice-breaker games, awkward scenarios and unexpected truths. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946070/Ten_Dates]Ten Dates[/url] is the much-anticipated sequel to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1353270/Five_Dates]Five Dates[/url] with even more content coming on launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42628831/3584858a73421523a9edf6e7613f7ce1eb8d6033.png[/img]

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946070/Ten_Dates]Ten Dates[/url] demo will be available October 3rd - October 10th exclusively over on Steam. The demo will have full controller support, Streamer mode, a whole new cast and location plus different endings available. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946070/Ten_Dates]Wishlist and Follow on Steam[/url] to see a broadcast of the demo too!

Misha, a millennial from London searching for that elusive in-person connection, tricks her best friend Ryan into going to a speed dating event with her. Each with their own five potential matches, Misha and Ryan must pluck up the courage and turn on the charm to date wildly different personalities.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946070/Ten_Dates

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946070/Ten_Dates]Ten Dates[/url] will be available in Q1 2023 on PC, Consoles & Mobile. Wishlist and Follow on Steam now!

notes.title: The Complex is on Steam Daily Deal!
notes.content:
[h2]The award winning The Complex is on Daily Deal![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36752512/7695aa4e2cacc72605e153fa22198aa785f192cd.png[/img]

After a major bio-weapon attack on London, two scientists find themselves in a locked-down laboratory with time, and air, running out. [b]The Complex[/b] is an interactive sci-fi thriller movie where your decisions lead to one of eight suspenseful endings.

Having treated the victims of a chemical attack in the totalitarian state of Kindar, Dr Amy Tenant is a leader in the advancement of Nanocell Technology. Now, in London, news breaks of a blood-vomiting civilian whose identity is far from coincidental. Reunited with an old friend, Amy is trapped in an impenetrable HQ of laboratories—a womb of scientific advancement with a perilous secret.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36752512/503b73e604e8a4e37b36d1bb895242ca0dcb79bb.jpg[/img]

[b]The Complex[/b] is written by Lynn Renee Maxcy, part of the Emmy award-winning writing team from The Handmaid’s Tale. The interactive movie stars Michelle Mylett (Letterkenny, Bad Blood), Kate Dickie (Game of Thrones, The Witch) and Al Weaver (Grantchester, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1628130/Who_Pressed_Mute_on_Uncle_Marcus]Who Pressed Mute on Uncle Marcus? [/url]) Featuring a guest acting performance by Twitch streamer and former Xbox UK presenter, Leah Viathan.
